items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: He used to make the chords, Paul Woodman, ain't he?

ctx.x: Buddy Petit. Yeah. I say he used to make some peculiar chords, didn't he?

Oh, yeah. Yeah. He's like Cindy Bessier, you know. He used to make the chords, Paul Woodman, ain't he? He said he couldn't like the music that Cindy Bessier made. John Rovershoe said that too. Yeah. And he used to play an old broken chord, get the melody out of it. Pack it up with paper like this, cigarette paper, his pads, you know. Did you work with, uh, you know, a little bit of a melody out of it? Mm-hm. Did you work with, uh, Be Cher much? and get the melody out of it. Pack it up with paper like this,…
Did you work with Bechet much? Did you play banjo with Bechet?
